summary: Issue trackers already provide much of the intake substrate: structured forms, triage queues, duplicate detection and routing suggestions. AI classification should remain reviewable because misrouting can silently hide urgent work.

items.text: Linear Triage Intelligence: suggests teams, projects, assignees and labels and identifies possible duplicates or related issues for a human to accept or decline.
Linear Asks: converts requests from Slack or email into structured issues and supports a managed intake workflow.
GitHub Issue Forms: YAML-defined required fields and validation provide a deterministic front door before optional AI normalization.
Jira Service Management Forms: conditional fields and reusable forms can capture the minimum evidence a proxy needs before routing work.
